description: Na₃BS₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-60°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.02 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-57°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.22 Å. B³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three S²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (1.83 Å) and one longer (1.85 Å) B-S bond length. There are two inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one B³⁺ atom. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one B³⁺ atom.
